description.en: 为DeepSeek Harness提供的免费网络搜索服务商：即使没有API密钥也可使用。Free web search provider for DeepSeek Harness:usable even without an API key.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个免费网页搜索，不用 API key，还能切换多个搜索引擎。

description.en: Zero-dependency, local-first Agent memory system: 4-arm recall + nebula visualization panel + MCP
description.zh: 零依赖的 DSH 本地记忆系统：JSONL 召回引擎配可视化星云面板，可选叠加 Hindsight 做语义增强。

description.en: Let AI Help users learn how to do a task,but not finish tasks for users.
description.zh: 让 AI 带你自己动手学会一个工具，而不是替你做完。

description.en: DSH — I'm dyslexic — Draws mermaid blocks right in the conversation and, when it helps, asks for a picture instead of a wall of text.
DSH 游戏商店：在 DeepSeek Harness 里装游戏、玩游戏，游戏和扩展都是插件，投稿走 GitHub · A game store for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里逛游戏商店，装游戏、玩游戏，还能投稿自己的作品。

description.en: Manage DeepSeek Harness skills in one plugin: distribute them through a git repository (install, update, contribute, merge), and switch each skill on / user-only / off from the composer or the Plugins page.

Free web search for DeepSeek Harness: 28 engines (Bing/DuckDuckGo/AnySearch/SearXNG/Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Firecrawl/Parallel keyless; Zhihu global/site via MCP and Perplexity/SerpBase/Serply/DeepSeek/You.com/Baidu/Kimi/Aliyun/Doubao/Zhipu/Bocha/Metaso with
A DeepSeek Harness plugin for Assistant Deepseek Budget.
在 DSH 中打开本地 HTML 原型，点元素写批注，提交后把批注作为消息发给当前会话，由 Agent 修改源码。
星主制作的大肥鱼世界，希望大家喜欢！
跨端互通：同一 DSH 账号下的会话、工作区、设备之间互通 —— 特征码链、内联邮件、云端中转站与自动备份
DSH LEWIS ENCHANTMENT · 附魔台｜开机动画：铺满当前窗口的完整开场、自定义视频与封面、启动检查更新和磨砂提示。
A durable, fenced cold-start scheduler and isolated Agent runner for DeepSeek Harness.
A minimal installable DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle.
Scoped, bounded, approval-gated long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness agents.
A bounded, append-only outcome evaluation ledger for the DSH personal assistant.

VibeDev 影视工作台：在 DeepSeek Harness 和 VibeDev 的右侧栏打开画布式影视工作台（剧本、分镜画布、图片/视频/音频生成、剪辑成片），模型与费用统一走 VibeDev 账号 · VibeDev Film: a canvas film workbench in the right sidebar of DeepSeek Harness and VibeDev (script, storyboard canvas, image/video/audio generation, e
Deterministic Host recovery and supervised self-evolution runbook for DeepSeek Harness.
Standalone personal assistant DSH plugin with multi-Bot profiles and an explicit Cloud Computer Broker boundary.

Cortex workbench for DeepSeek Harness: the original Cortex UI (vulnerabilities, client findings, assets, internal operations, Memory Nebula, snapshots, retest, standalone Web Fuzzer with raw/JSON/render responses, mini-program reversing), project/selected
MemOS Cloud lifecycle memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness
Independent, bounded task acceptance verification with durable contracts and receipts.
Approval-gated behavioural self-evolution for the DSH personal assistant.
Persistent owner-scoped business goals over the native DSH goal domain.
550C 皮肤：把 DeepSeek Harness 的整个界面换成 550C 控制台——四套磷光配色（琥珀/绿/青/白）、扫描线与暗角、等宽字体、机器读数栏，与 dsh-550c-boot 的开机片头同一套视觉。

DSH 插件:共享 Playwright 浏览器自动化(39 个 browser_* 工具,含 what 意图语义定位(一次调用替代快照→查找→点击)、SoM 标徽看图点击与零命中截图兜底、SPA ref 软失效重锚定、open Shadow DOM 组合树穿透、跨 Frame/IFrame 定位、视口感知动态快照、批量表单智能填充、点击效果验证与定位失败遥测、Playwright 规范代码导出、批处理、视觉回归、选择器自愈、增量快照)+ 人机协作(面板点选教学 browser_pick_element、

Import one or more Clash/mihomo subscriptions and route the Harness outbound traffic through the private core bundled with this plugin. Runs on Windows, Linux (Ubuntu 22.04/24.04/26.04 LTS) and macOS: the core is fetched and SHA-256 verified on platforms
AdaptiqAI for DeepSeek Harness: models with 5M-token native memory and Knowledge. Sign up, get a model and work without leaving the harness
A calmer reading view for DeepSeek Harness: native process details, live reasoning, and clean final answers. Fork adds answer message bubbles with a settings switch.
Subagents: configure models and reasoning effort, review each subagent's last-used model, and use per-session delegation mode.
用经历去塑造小肥鱼的插件：聊过的事记得住，心情会变还能自己记，会自己长出性格，对谁都有好恶，闲着时还会自己找点事做；记得每句话被接住没有，会生闷气也会自己回头想，错题攒够三次就长成规矩，还会回头看自己怎么变的。
WSL run mode for DeepSeek Harness Desktop on Windows: run chosen tasks, and the plugins they use, in WSL from the Desktop window

macOS-native theme for DeepSeek Harness: a floating translucent workbench window on a sky-blue gradient desktop, with the macOS light and dark palettes. Pure UI plugin — the browser half stacks a token override layer on the active theme and injects the st
Unrestricted: a session preset that removes the limits on what the model answers and delivers complete results, only in sessions that pick it. May get your account banned.
Finance Ops suite: one-command install for dsh-einvoice, dsh-bankrec, dsh-ap-three-way and dsh-travel-recon.
description.zh: 一条命令装齐发票、银行对账、三单匹配和差旅报销四个财务插件，财务日常一次搞定。

description.en: trace based agent memory system
description.zh: 给 DSH 智能体加一层防失忆记忆，压缩时顺手存档、按需翻找历史，报错还能秒救。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上「删除会话」：侧栏菜单一键删除，递归清理子会话、日志、投影缓存、搜索索引与工作区记账。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 补上删除会话功能，一键连子会话、日志和缓存一起清干净。

description.en: Community plugins, developer tooling, and shared utilities for extending DeepSeek Harness — built as an Nx + pnpm monorepo.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供社区插件、开发者工具和共享工具库，基于 Nx + pnpm 构建，方便扩展和集成。

description.en: Expose DeepSeek Harness (dsh) as an OpenAI-compatible API server — /v1/chat/completions + /v1/models, backed by real agent sessions with tools and workspaces. 把 DeepSeek Harness 暴露为 OpenAI 兼容 API 服务端。
dsh用来进行数学计算的工具整合包，内含多个数学工具
DeepSeek Harness 插件：让 agent 默认用中文思考与回复（移植自 superpowers-zh）
Permanently delete DSH sessions from the file system, right from the sidebar conversation menu — 在 DSH 侧边栏菜单真正物理删除会话，而非归档隐藏。
Composer + button: search Feishu docs, drive files, group chats, messages and contacts; picker grows out of the composer with a bottom search field and inserts an agent-readable reference.
DS Bot: a team of long-lived Bots for DeepSeek Harness, with Main Bots, Bot-to-Bot messages and group chats

Let your agent understand your players. Glitchless for DeepSeek Harness: game observability tools over MCP (ranked findings, frame times, errors, where players quit, each game's own dashboard) and skills that add Glitchless to a game in Unity, Godot, Unre
description.zh: 让 AI 助手读懂玩家真实体验，通过 MCP 收集游戏帧率卡顿与报错数据，并支持 Unity、Godot、虚幻等引擎。

description.en: Lazy capability catalog for DeepSeek Harness: one compact index plus search/describe/call meta-tools for MCP tools and skills, instead of every schema on every request
description.zh: 把 MCP 工具和 skill 收进一个精简索引，按会话开关，省下大量输入 token。

description.en: Delegation Mode: a per-session switch where the main agent plans, delegates, and reviews while subagents carry out the work.
Embedded identity and payment-governance trust plane for multi-agent cross-border payment workflows.
DSH plugin: one-click account balance & quota panel for multiple AI providers (DeepSeek, Zhipu GLM, Z.ai, Moonshot, MiniMax, StepFun, SiliconFlow, OpenRouter, xAI).

Lightweight, self-contained desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness — an in-app floating pet driven by session activity, a settings panel, and a transparent always-on-top window that reuses the DSH host's Electron runtime (path resolution mirrors dsh-pet).

ModelGo is a stable, enterprise-grade AI model API platform: one API key calls the latest mainstream models such as Claude, GPT, Gemini and DeepSeek, compatible with the OpenAI and Anthropic protocols. Choose models flexibly for AI coding and agent workflows, with per-call cost records, a visual dashboard, and budget and spending-limit management.
description.zh: ModelGo 是稳定的企业级 AI 大模型 API 平台，一个 API Key 即可调用 Claude、GPT、Gemini、DeepSeek 等最新主流模型，兼容 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 协议。为 AI 编程和 Agent 工作流灵活选择模型，调用费用逐笔可查，提供可视化看板，支持预算与消费上限管理。

description.en: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugins: in-place conversation rewind with file restore, and real session deletion with trash + audit log.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一套靠谱的插件，能真正删除会话并放进回收站，还能记录审计日志。

description.en: Restores the collapsed sidebar as a 56px icon rail on the Windows desktop client, keeping panels, New Session and the workspace entry clickable, with a hover flyout card for workspace sessions.
description.zh: 在 Windows 桌面端把收起的侧边栏还原成 56px 图标轨道，面板、新建会话与工作区入口保持可点，悬停时在轨道右侧浮出工作区会话卡片。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）社区插件：统一管理工具与技能的常驻、按需和禁用策略，提供重复调用提醒、交替循环识别、无进展局部保护及本次启动统计。
description.zh: 统一管理工具和技能的常驻、按需与禁用策略，自动识别重复调用和死循环，防止 AI 空转。

description.en: Adds a Chats/Files switch to the left-sidebar Workspace header that swaps the session list for a lazily loaded tree of the current session's workspace. Files and folders can be dragged into the composer as @path references; clicking a file opens the built-in preview; the right-click menu reveals a file in the system file manager or copies its path; entries carry VS Code-style Git status (modified, untracked, added, deleted, conflict, ignored) relative to the last commit.
description.zh: 在左侧栏「工作区」标题旁加入「对话 | 文件」切换，把会话列表换成当前会话工作区的按需加载文件树。文件和文件夹可拖进输入框作为 @路径 引用；单击文件打开自带预览；右键可在系统文件管理器中打开所在文件夹或复制路径；条目按 VS Code 的方式显示相对最近一次提交的 Git 状态（修改、未跟踪、新增、删除、冲突、忽略）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) bundle that registers the REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) MCP server as mcp__rea__* tools — third-party adapter
description.zh: 把 REA 逆向工程 MCP 服务器接进 DSH，让你直接调用工具拆解分析任意目标。

description.en: Session-aware MCP bridge and sidebar UI for BugX autonomous code review and testing in DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中运行 BugX 自主代码审查与智能测试的会话级 MCP 桥接与侧边栏插件。

description.en: Classics-reading companion skill for Confucian, Buddhist and Daoist texts: a 30-lesson curriculum with spaced retrieval review, 29 guided readings, a bundled library of 23 full-text files, and a sage-dialogue mode that answers "how would X see my situation" with labeled hypothetical answers and one small action. Quotes only from the bundled texts or user-provided originals.
description.zh: 儒释道经典陪读技能：三十次课表配间隔检索复习，二十九篇精讲，内置 23 个全本原文文件；对谈模式按圣贤内核推演"某某会怎么看我这件事"，标拟答并落一步行动。引文只出自内置原文或用户提供的原文。

description.en: Desktop task radar for DSH: a draggable always-on-top capsule showing running sessions, pending approvals and questions, with inline approve/answer and completion banners. Bundles agent-bridge (Codex / Claude / WorkBuddy), a delivery judge and office-artifact scanning. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH 桌面任务雷达：可拖动的置顶小胶囊，显示运行中的会话、待批准与提问，支持就地批准或回答并弹出完成横幅；同时整合 Codex/Claude/WorkBuddy 外部任务、交付判别与办公产物扫描。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Left-sidebar panel that reads this machine's local agent-client session logs (Claude desktop, Qwen Work, WorkBuddy, MiniMax Code, DeepSeek Harness) and shows per-client session counts and token consumption for today, the current week, or the current month, with a token-share donut.
description.zh: 左侧栏面板，读取本机多个 Agent 客户端（Claude 桌面端、千问办公、WorkBuddy、MiniMax Code、DeepSeek Harness）的本地会话日志，按今天 / 本周 / 本月展示各客户端的会话数与 token 消耗，并给出用量占比环形图。

description.en: Shows each Alibaba Cloud voucher's remaining balance, used amount and expiry date in a sidebar page, read through the read-only BSS OpenAPI. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在侧栏页面显示阿里云每张代金券的剩余余额、已抵扣金额与到期时间，数据经只读 BSS OpenAPI 获取。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: macOS floating card for DeepSeek Harness: a tool asking for approval, a question waiting for an answer, or a finished turn shows up on screen, and clicking an option resolves it in DSH. Positions, width, font scale and accent are configurable, including next to the pointer.
description.zh: macOS 悬浮卡片：审批、提问、回合结束三种时刻弹卡，点选项即等于在 DSH 里作答；完成卡可跨桌面、跨 workspace 回到会话，并把光标和鼠标指针放回输入框。

description.en: Connects DSH to the official Antigravity ACP agent over stdio, checks the official distribution archive against a pinned digest before each launch, and can open a local macOS sign-in helper on request.
description.zh: 通过标准输入输出连接官方 Antigravity ACP 程序，每次启动前按锁定的摘要校验官方归档，可由用户主动唤起本机 macOS 登录助手。

description.en: Turns local Breeze TTS 2 into a shared voice-output service for DSH: a settings panel, cloned-voice sync between the desktop and self-managed modes, and a delivery tone picked by keywords or by a model that can read a chat plugin’s recent messages. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把本机 Breeze TTS 2 接成 DSH 的通用语音输出：带设置面板，桌面模式与本机自管模式之间的克隆音色自动同步，语气可由关键词判断，也可交给模型并参考聊天插件最近的对话。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Annotate elements in the right-Sidebar browser (Desktop): click one element or drag a marquee to select a region, then send DOM paths and a change request to the agent. Includes an action that opens a local HTML preview in the browser for annotation. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 圈选右侧浏览器里的页面元素发给 AI：单击选一个，按住拖框选一片（弹窗、卡片组、工具条），自动带上 DOM 路径、坐标和文本；HTML 预览可直接一键转到浏览器里标注。仅桌面端。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Opens a chat window built from the official chat-demo inside DSH, with its model calls relayed through your DSH account so no API key is needed: chat, deep thinking and web search, a per-reply token and estimated-cost label, and a right-edge launcher or Ctrl/Command+Shift+K.
description.zh: 把修改自官方 chat-demo 的对话窗口嵌进 DSH：模型请求经宿主用当前 DSH 账号转发、不用填 API Key，含对话、深度思考与联网搜索，每轮回答下方显示 token 与估算费用，右侧常驻入口或 Ctrl/⌘+Shift+K 打开。

description.en: Read and write ChemDraw .cdx files from DSH: structures, stereo geometry, captions, reaction arrows and 3D conformers, through 12 tools whose writes are dry-run by default and re-read for verification. Requires an installed, activated ChemDraw; before first use copy CambridgeSoft.ChemScript.dll into the plugin bin/ folder and set CHEMDRAW_HOME to the ChemDraw install directory.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里读写 ChemDraw 的 .cdx 文件：结构、立体几何、标注、反应箭头和 3D 构象，共 12 个工具；写操作默认 dry-run，落盘前重新读回校验。需要本机已安装并激活 ChemDraw，首次使用前要把 CambridgeSoft.ChemScript.dll 复制到插件的 bin/ 目录、并设置 CHEMDRAW_HOME 指向 ChemDraw 安装目录。

description.en: Drives a local ChemDraw installation on Windows through seven agent tools: draw and clean up structures as PNG/SVG/CDX, predict 1H and 13C NMR spectra with ChemNMR, convert chemical formats, and recognise a structure from an image. Needs ChemDraw Suite 23.x and Python 3.10 on the machine.
description.zh: 把本机 ChemDraw 变成智能体能力，提供七个工具：绘制并美化结构（PNG/SVG/CDX）、用 ChemNMR 预测 1H/13C 核磁、化学格式互转、从图片识别结构。需要机器上装有 ChemDraw Suite 23.x 与 Python 3.10。

description.en: Runlang: a courtyard-video skin for the DSH Web UI with smoked-glass panels, a wallpaper panel (upload, shader, Wallpaper Engine), a corner music player with repeat/shuffle and a draggable frame-accurate progress bar, a background-video sound control, and a mint cat companion. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: Runlang：DSH Web UI 的古风庭院动态壁纸皮肤——烟熏玻璃面板、壁纸面板（上传/着色器/Wallpaper Engine）、右上角音乐播放器（单曲循环/随机/拖动进度条）、壁纸视频声音开关，附薄荷小猫桌宠。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Persistent C/C++ symbol index for DeepSeek Harness: symbol search, go-to-definition, find-references, callers/callees, call graph and a right-sidebar panel, plus @ symbol completion in the composer.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化 C/C++ 符号索引：符号搜索、跳转定义、引用、调用者/被调用者、调用关系图与右侧栏面板，以及输入框 @ 符号补全。

description.en: Connects signed-in Qoder CN and Qoder desktop accounts as DSH model providers on Windows, with credit balances and model controls. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 将 Windows 上已登录的 Qoder CN 和 Qoder 桌面账号接入 DSH 模型选择器，并提供积分查询与模型管理。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Ctrl+F find bar over a DSH session transcript: every hit is highlighted in place with the CSS Custom Highlight API without touching the transcript DOM, stepping jumps to the nearest match and holds the scroll position against the tail follower, hits clear when the session changes, and message text stays natively selectable for Ctrl+C.
description.zh: DSH 会话内的 Ctrl+F 查找与复制插件：命中通过 CSS Custom Highlight API 原地高亮、不改写会话 DOM，逐个跳转按离视野最近优先并顶住流式输出的自动跟底，切换会话即清空命中，消息正文保持原生可选中并可直接 Ctrl+C 复制。

description.en: Bring coserwiki cosplay events into DSH — browse every event and filter by city. When a cosplayer you follow appears, the event gets a “Watched” badge and you get a popup one month and one week before it starts; reminders missed while DSH was closed are replayed next time. Edit the watchlist in Settings, changes apply immediately.
description.zh: 把 coserwiki 的漫展活动接进 DSH——一屏浏览全部场次、按城市筛选。关注的 Coser 达人参演时会自动标「关注」，并在活动开始前 1 个月、1 周各弹窗提醒一次；关掉 DSH 期间错过的提醒下次打开会补弹。关注名单在插件设置里修改，保存即生效。

description.en: Markdown ticket types plus a single-account currency for DSH agents: five wallet tools (list, request, exchange, redeem, templates), approval-gated issuing, md5-bound one-shot tickets with a transaction ledger, and a Web panel in Settings or the right sidebar. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 给 DSH agent 的票夹：md 模板即票种 + 单账户鲸圆券 + md5 绑定的一次性票据；5 个钱包工具（列模板、查票、要票、自主兑换、核销）+ 审批签发 + 流水账 + 设置页/右侧栏 Web 面板。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Custom wallpaper and frosted-glass theme for DSH: 2 built-in presets, local IndexedDB image upload, image URL support, and live contrast controls for sidebars and input box.
description.zh: DSH 自定义背景壁纸与毛玻璃主题：内置 2 张精选壁纸，支持本地 IndexedDB 上传图片与网络链接，并可实时调节侧边栏、任务栏与输入框对比度。

description.en: DeepSeek model almanac for DSH: long-press or right-click the composer model control to browse model families and a 31-day release calendar, compare models, and view pricing synced from api-docs.deepseek.com.
description.zh: DSH 的 DeepSeek 模型档案：长按或右键输入框模型控件，浏览模型家族与 31 天发布月历、对比模型，并查看从 api-docs.deepseek.com 同步的定价。

description.en: Imports DeepSeek web chat history into DeepSeek Harness as resumable sessions, with official ZIP/JSON, split conversations, browser records, JSONL, merge/dedupe, branch selection, summaries and cost estimates. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek 网页端聊天历史导入 DeepSeek Harness，支持官方 ZIP/JSON、拆分文件、浏览器记录、JSONL、多文件合并去重、版本选择、摘要与费用预估。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Visually compose DevOps pipelines, run them locally or over SSH, and follow live logs while they execute. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 可视化编排 DevOps 流水线，在本地或经 SSH 远端执行，并实时跟踪运行日志。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Puts a persistent capture frame on the desktop and inserts the framed region into the chat as an image attachment, without closing the frame between shots. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在桌面放一个常驻取景框，点一下就把框内画面作为图片附件插入对话，框不关闭可连续拍多张。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Edits ask_user_question option cards before answering: select the closest option, adjust its label and details in place, and submit the original choice together with your revision.
description.zh: 在 ask_user_question 的选择题卡片中选中接近的选项后，就地修改选项名称与细节，提交时保留原选项并把修改说明一起带给模型。

description.en: Turns the last 30 days (7 / 30 / 90 selectable) of Session failures into an error museum, with each hall grouping failures by what the model did next (restored, retried verbatim, handed back, stalled) and every exhibit keeping the calls before and after plus the verbatim error. Logs are read locally, and only the selected Session's summary reaches the configured model when you press audit.
description.zh: 把最近 30 天（可切 7 / 30 / 90 天）的会话可确认失败做成「错误博物馆」，展品按模型失败后的处置（复原 / 重试 / 交还 / 搁置）分馆陈列，保留失败前后的调用与错误原文。会话日志只在本机读取，只有点「用模型深挖」时才把该会话摘要发给已配置的模型。

description.en: Indexed full-text excerpt search through AI4Scholar with a dedicated reading workspace, source-type filters and saved offline HTML/CSV reports; optional AI synthesis preserves original passages and source metadata.
description.zh: 通过 AI4Scholar 检索已索引的全文片段，提供独立阅读工作台、来源类型筛选与本地 HTML/CSV 报告；可用 AI 整理已有报告，同时保留原文与来源信息。

description.en: Connect a GitHub account and work with it from a Settings page: browse repositories with files and a collapsible code tree, read and comment on issues and pull requests, review diffs and merge, list Actions runs with their jobs, logs, re-run and cancel, commit files through the API, and record star history with a daily report. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 连接 GitHub 账号，在设置页里看仓库与可折叠的代码树、读写 issue 与 PR、看 diff 并合并、列 Actions 运行与日志并重跑或取消、通过 API 提交文件，还会按天记录 star 历史并生成日报。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Select text anywhere in DSH and a translate button appears; click it to translate with your default model in a separate one-off call, shown in place in the same floating panel. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在 DSH 任意位置选中文字，右侧浮出翻译按钮；点击后用默认大模型新发一次独立调用翻译，并在同一悬浮面板里原地显示译文。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Maps an unfamiliar industry in hours: JD anchoring, sector context, four benchmark companies, a scored talent map, and a client-ready HTML/docx report plus a talent-map spreadsheet. Every fact carries a source tier, every stage is time-boxed, and everything serves one question — can I call this person.
description.zh: 数小时内吃透陌生赛道：JD 锚定、行业认知、4 家标杆公司、带评分的人才地图，交付客户版 HTML/docx 报告与人才地图 Excel。每条事实标注来源等级，每个阶段时间盒，所有信息只服务于一个问题——这个人能不能打电话。

description.en: Reads the Codex (ChatGPT) subscription quota already on your machine and draws with it: plan, weekly usage and reset time in a sidebar panel, one prompt to a PNG saved locally, with history. No API key, no extra billing. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 读取本机已有的 Codex（ChatGPT 订阅）额度并直接生图：侧栏显示套餐、本周已用与重置时间，写一句话出 PNG 存到本机并保留历史。不需要 API key，不额外计费。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Folds every left-sidebar panel entry into a single "Collection" row, and keeps the per-entry hide/show switches. Hovering the row slides out a 448px two-column card: the panel entries come first, then the shell's own overflow entries (browse plugins, create a plugin), dealt row by row into the same grid — no divider, no extra group, no nested popup. The first click never navigates: with nothing selected the row only reveals the card. Picking an entry selects it and opens that panel exactly like its own row would; the row then reads "Collection / \[icon] name" and clicking it goes straight there, while hovering still lets you switch. Keyboard: arrows walk the visual order, left/right move within a row, Enter opens, Esc closes and returns focus. Collapsing the sidebar to a 36px rail leaves only the collection glyph plus a dot when something is selected. A switch in Settings → Left menu turns the whole thing off and restores the plain row list; the user's own hidden set is never rewritten.
description.zh: 把左侧菜单的每个面板入口收进一行「集合」，同时保留逐项的隐藏/显示开关。悬浮这一行会从右侧滑出一张 448px 双列卡片：面板入口在前，外壳自己的溢出条目（浏览更多插件、创建你的插件）在后，一起逐行铺进同一个网格——没有分隔线、没有额外分组、没有第二层弹窗。首次点击不会跳转：还没选过任何入口时，这一行只把卡片打开。选中某一项既记下选择、也像点原来那一行一样打开该面板；行文字随即变成「集合 / 图标 名称」，再点它就直接过去，悬浮仍然可以换。键盘：方向键按视觉顺序走，左右在同一行里挪，Enter 打开，Esc 关闭并把焦点还给行。侧栏折叠成 36px 图标轨时只留集合图标，有选中项时点一个小圆点。设置 → 左栏菜单里的开关可以整体关掉、恢复原来的一行一个；用户自己的隐藏集合不会被改写。

description.en: Live output speed (tok/s) in the composer: a resident reading that stays put through pauses and Turns, counting the stream the conversation already receives, so nothing extra is requested.
description.zh: 输入框下方的实时输出速度（tok/s）：常驻读数，跨停顿与轮次都不会消失；只用会话已收到的流计数，不额外发请求。

description.en: Runs the magpie vendor-plugin ecosystem inside DSH: inherits installed plugins and signed-in accounts from ~/.config/magpie, registers every provider as a model route, and ships a dual-surface panel — the magpie web UI on desktop plus a native mobile panel for DSH Go (provider cards, quota windows, usage stats, plugin store with one-click install), with a quota strip above the composer and a per-turn usage footnote. 84 tests.
description.zh: 在 DSH 进程内直接运行 magpie 的供应商插件：继承 ~/.config/magpie 里已装的插件与已登录的账号，把每个供应商注册成一条模型路由，提供双端面板——桌面是 magpie 原版 Web UI，手机（DSH Go）是原生插件面板（平台卡片、额度窗口、用量统计、插件商店一键安装），另有输入框上方的额度条与每回合的消耗脚注。84 条测试。

description.en: Renders mermaid code fences in DeepSeek Harness chat as inline SVG using a vendored Pele engine, with theme-token color bridging; streaming, oversized, or unparseable sources stay as plain code blocks.
description.zh: 使用内置 Pele 引擎将聊天中的 mermaid 代码围栏渲染为内联 SVG，配色桥接主题令牌；流式、超长或无法解析的源码保持普通代码块。

description.en: A plain-text notepad opened from the session header, in the spirit of Windows Notepad: multiple pages with draggable tabs, whole-page zoom, a draggable and resizable panel that pins open, and a trash that restores or permanently deletes closed pages. Everything is stored locally in the browser.
description.zh: 从会话标题栏展开的纯文本记事本（Windows 记事本风格）：多页便签、标签可拖拽排序、整体缩放，面板可拖动可拉伸并可钉住，被关闭的页面进入可恢复或彻底删除的回收站。全部内容只保存在本机浏览器里。

description.en: Connect Android and HarmonyOS phones to DSH from Settings → Mobile devices, over WebUSB in the browser page or through the local adb/hdc CLI: run shell commands, take screenshots, push and pull files, install and uninstall apps, and switch between several phones. On HarmonyOS it can also sign an unsigned HAP with your own Huawei ID — it shows the DevEco OAuth page as a QR code, obtains a debug certificate and a device-bound provisioning profile from AGC, signs locally with hap-sign-tool and installs the result, reading the bundle name from the HAP. Five native tools (devices / exec / screenshot / install / sign_install) let other agents drive a phone. Credentials stay on the local machine.
description.zh: 在 DSH「设置 → 移动设备」里连接安卓与鸿蒙手机：可用浏览器页面的 WebUSB，也可用运行 DSH 那台机器上的 adb/hdc 命令行。执行 shell、截图、推拉文件、安装卸载应用，多台手机可同时连接并切换。鸿蒙侧还能用自己的华为账号给未签名 HAP 做 ID 自签：以二维码方式打开 DevEco 授权页，向 AGC 申请绑定本机 UDID 的调试证书与 Profile，本地 hap-sign-tool 签好后装机，包名从 HAP 自动读取。另注册了 5 个原生工具（devices / exec / screenshot / install / sign_install）供其他 agent 调用。凭证只保存在本机。

description.en: Per-model parameter flyout in the DSH model list: context presets, thinking toggle and reasoning levels, with automatic Bailian compatibility and uninstall rollback of config writes.
description.zh: 模型列表内逐模型参数面板：上下文预设、思考开关与强度档位，百炼端点自动兼容，卸载自动回滚配置写入。

description.en: NBA daily board in the DSH sidebar with game scores and quarter lines, per-game box scores, East/West standings and a top-ten news feed, in Simplified Chinese. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 侧边栏 NBA 每日看板：当天比分与分节数据、单场技术统计、东西部排名、热点新闻 TOP10，全部简体中文。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Connects Nezha Monitoring's built-in MCP server to DeepSeek Harness, adding tools for server status, one-shot commands, remote file read/write/delete and large-file transfer links, with a settings page for the dashboard URL and PAT.
description.zh: 把哪吒监控内置的 MCP 服务接入 DeepSeek Harness，新增服务器状态、一次性命令执行、远程文件读写/删除和大文件传输链接等工具，并提供管理面板地址与 PAT 的设置页。

description.en: Windows-only battery levels for wireless peripherals in DSH, with a bottom bar, agent tools, low-battery notifications and an adapter market.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中读取 Windows 无线外设电量，提供底栏、agent 工具、低电量通知和适配器市场。

description.en: Tab and Shift+Tab cycle the composer between normal and plan mode by calling the official /plan handler directly, so no command row is written to the conversation; while a slash or trigger menu is open the key stays with the menu.
description.zh: 在输入框用 Tab 正向、Shift+Tab 反向切换普通 / 计划模式，直调官方 /plan 处理器，因此会话里不会多出命令行记录；斜杠或触发菜单打开时按键先归菜单。

description.en: Create sessions from reusable templates for role instructions, per-session memory, tools and usage limits, with shared workspace documents and a leader role for dispatching tasks to selected sessions.
description.zh: 用火种模板为会话配置角色指令、独立记忆、工具和用量上限，按权限共享工作区文档，由领袖向指定锻造会话派工。

description.en: Live AI task tree in the right sidebar: per-step status, blockers, artifacts, and a compact progress dock above the composer.
description.zh: 在右侧栏实时显示 AI 任务树：每一步状态、阻塞原因、产物，以及输入框上方的紧凑进度条。

description.en: Binds one Miniconda environment to each workspace and skill, and creates or deletes conda environments or installs and removes pip packages from a sidebar page.
description.zh: 为每个工作区和技能绑定一个 Miniconda 环境，并可在侧边栏页面创建或删除 conda 环境、安装或卸载 pip 包。

description.en: Run trusted Python scripts in the workspace, read text from searchable PDFs, and export DOCX to PDF through Microsoft Word on Windows.
description.zh: 在工作区运行受信任的 Python 脚本、读取可搜索 PDF 的文本，并在 Windows 上通过 Microsoft Word 把 DOCX 导出为 PDF。

description.en: A Bot team for DeepSeek Harness: each Bot keeps its own role prompt, project memory, avatar and id, and a sidebar roster shows who is idle, who is working, and who is waiting for your review. The lead dispatches a task to one Bot, which works in its own subagent session and returns a result the lead accepts or rejects with a grade that counts toward that Bot's experience; rules taught to a Bot are written into its project memory, and a Bot accumulating experience gains levels and can be promoted. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 配一支 Bot 团队：每只 Bot 有自己的职责提示、项目记忆、头像和 ID，侧边栏成员卡显示谁在待命、谁在干活、谁等你验收。领队把活派给某只 Bot，它在自己的子会话里干完回结果，领队按交付物验收并给评分，评分折算成它的经验；教给它的规矩写进它的项目记忆，经验攒够就升级、还能升阶。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Serial-port capture and troubleshooting for DeepSeek Harness: lossless recordings with a SQLite index, incremental tail, byte-level lookup, workspace scan marks and a live FSM middleware, plus a web panel. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的串口抓取与排障插件：无损录制与 SQLite 索引、增量读取、字节级回查、工作区扫描标记、实时状态机中间件，并提供 Web 面板。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Deletes sessions for real and keeps them restorable — detaches the registry through the official API, moves the log into a 7-day recycle bin with an atomic rename, and sweeps orphan log directories and projection caches. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 真正删除会话且可还原——通过官方 API 解绑注册表，把日志原子移动到保留 7 天的回收站，并清理孤儿日志目录与孤儿投影缓存。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Lets two existing DSH sessions talk to each other on a daily schedule. Pick session A and B, which one speaks first, a purpose, a round count and a time of day; each delivered turn carries the same rules block (purpose, rounds, per-message character limit) and waits for the reply with a configurable timeout. The sidebar panel lists sessions by their own title and last-update time, saves the schedule, shows the per-round status and the transcript of the current run, keeps a local markdown log per conversation, and lets a run be started or stopped by hand. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 每天到点让两个已有的 DSH 会话互相对话。选好会话 A、B、谁先说、目的、轮次与时间；每一次投递都附带同一份规则（目的、轮次、单条字数上限），并按可配置的超时等待回话。侧栏面板按会话自己的名字与最后更新时间列出会话，可保存配置、查看本轮逐条状态与本次对白，把每场对话写成本地 markdown 记录，也支持手动开始与停止。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Aggregates the per-session metadata that the small DSH plugins keep in their own files — stars, todos, boxes and finish alerts — into one read-only GET /session-meta response for the workspace UI and for other plugins, replacing four routes and four reads. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把各小插件各自保存的会话元数据（星标、待办、盒子、结束提醒）只读聚合到同一个 GET /session-meta，供工作区界面和其他插件一次读全，替代四条路由、四次读取。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Loads project rule files in AGENTS.md then CLAUDE.md order: when an earlier file exists in the same directory, the later CLAUDE.md is skipped, avoiding duplicate injection and saving context.
description.zh: 按 AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md 的先后顺序加载项目规则文件：同目录存在靠前文件时跳过靠后的 CLAUDE.md，避免重复注入、节省上下文。

description.en: Adds a prompt library button at the left of the input box: manage prompts (add, edit, delete, search, groups), insert with one click or Enter/Tab, save prompt combinations, and sync over WebDAV. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在输入框左侧新增提示词库按钮：弹窗管理提示词（增删改查、分组），一键或回车/Tab 插入，支持组合预设与 WebDAV 同步。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Adds a Load tab at the top of the current conversation showing what was injected to the model (system prompt, instruction files, skills, tools, environment snapshot), with per-block AI translation. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在当前对话顶部新增「加载」标签，展示本次注入给模型的系统提示词、指令文件、技能、工具与环境快照，并支持逐块 AI 翻译。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Moves a stored Session into a recoverable trash directory instead of deleting it outright: the sidebar session menu sends it to the trash, Settings › Session trash restores it byte-identically or deletes it permanently, and a session_trash tool exposes the same list, delete, restore and purge actions to the agent. A Session still loaded in the running Host is refused instead of moved.
description.zh: 把已落盘的会话移入可恢复的回收站，而不是直接删除：会话行的「⋯」菜单删除后进入回收站，设置 › 会话回收站 可把它逐字节恢复回原位或彻底删除，同样的 list / delete / restore / purge 也通过 session_trash 工具提供给 Agent。仍被当前 Host 加载的会话会被拒绝移动。

description.en: In the sidebar file preview, copy or insert a file reference @relative/path with one click, and when code lines are selected, a reference with a line range such as @path#L92-L94.
description.zh: 在右侧文件预览中一键复制/插入文件引用 @相对路径；选中代码行时可复制/插入带行号的引用 @相对路径#L92-L94。

description.en: Adds a search button at the top-right of the sidebar that opens a Vite-style floating window to fuzzy-search workspace files and folders by path; selecting a file opens it in the right preview.
description.zh: 在右侧栏右上角新增搜索按钮，打开 Vite 风格悬浮窗按路径模糊搜索工作区文件/文件夹，选中后在右侧预览打开。

description.en: Select text in a sidebar document preview to quote it into the composer with your comment on the same line; frame a picture in a Word, PowerPoint or PDF preview to ask for changes; drop a file on the sidebar to open it there; and rewrite the draft prompt by first finding what it is missing rather than paraphrasing it.
description.zh: 在侧栏文档预览里选中原文即可引用进输入框、批注紧跟同一行；在 Word/PPT/PDF 预览里框选一张图提出修改意见；把文件拖进侧栏直接打开；改写提示词时先找出草稿缺什么，再据此补齐，而不是换个说法。

description.en: Adds Close Left, Close Right, Close Others and Close All to the right-click menu of sidebar tabs, acting on the current pane and keeping the Start guide tab.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏 tab 的右键菜单里追加关闭左侧/关闭右侧/关闭其他/关闭全部，只作用于当前栏并保留「开始」页。

description.en: Two-pane model and reasoning-effort picker replacing conversation.input.model with Pointer Events drag-to-reorder, an external sliding effort bar, custom folders with per-folder aliases, vendor color swatches, bilingual UI, and JSON backup/restore.
description.zh: 接管 conversation.input.model 插槽的双栏模型与思考强度选择器：支持 Pointer Events 拖拽排序、外置划动思考强度条、自定义文件夹与专属模型别名、厂商圆点调色盘、中英切换及 JSON 备份恢复。

description.en: Read fluorescence spectra with five offline tools: excitation wavelength, scan range, peak position, height, FWHM and area, plus wavelength-range queries and plots. Reads Gangdong .spw raw files directly; other brands must be exported to CSV/TXT first.
description.zh: 用 5 个离线工具读荧光光谱：激发波长、扫描范围、峰位、峰高、半高宽和积分面积，支持区间取数与出图。只能直接读港东（天津港东）荧光分光光度计的 .spw 原始文件，其它品牌需先在仪器软件里导出为 CSV/TXT。

description.en: Delegate coding tasks from Codex and Antigravity to DSH over 11 bounded MCP tools: one-click host integration, isolated Git worktrees with cross-subtask reuse, silent long waits, per-call permission approval, and structured delivery review.
description.zh: 通过 11 个有界 MCP 工具将 Codex 与 Antigravity 的编码任务委派给 DSH 执行：支持一键宿主集成、隔离 Git 工作树与跨子包复用、静默长等、按参数指纹单次权限审批及结构化交付验收。

description.en: Closes subagents whose work is done — stops their running work, archives the session, and releases the activation slot — with a tree overview that marks closed members and a command that restores them.
description.zh: 关闭已用完的子代理：停止其工作、归档会话并释放激活槽位，另提供带关闭标记的团队花名册与恢复命令。

description.en: Adds one button to the composer toolbar that turns the model thinking on or off on each click, cycling between off and the last reasoning level it used.
description.zh: 在输入框工具行加一个按钮：点一下关闭模型思考，再点一下回到上次的思考档位，如此循环。

description.en: Delivery budget for the composer — set 20 minutes and the model sees an exact remaining time before every step, ships a rough-but-usable version by the halfway point, and at the deadline stops starting new work and hands over what it has with the gaps written out. Adds a per-session timebox tool (status / request_more / deliver / stop) and a countdown pill under the input.
description.zh: 输入框下方设一个交付预算——每一步模型都能看到精确剩余时间，过半先出粗糙但可用的版本，到点停止开新工并交出产物与缺口说明；带按会话的 timebox 工具（status / request_more / deliver / stop）与输入框下方的倒计时胶囊。

description.en: Embed your tokens.ci usage graph in the DSH left sidebar footer: paste official HTML embed code or username, switch between compact hover-zoom popover, direct fit, and horizontal scroll.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧边栏底部嵌入 tokens.ci 用量热力图：支持直接粘贴官方 HTML embed 代码或填写用户名，提供悬停高清放大浮层、等比缩放与横向滚动三种模式。

description.en: Sidebar panel for DeepSeek Harness that shows DeepSeek official account (or a pasted API key) and several new-api relay station balances with today's spend, marks peak and off-peak pricing on the official site, and rotates between the sites you enable. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏用量面板：显示 DeepSeek 官方账号（或手填 API key）与多个 new-api 中转站的余额与今日消耗，官方站点标注峰谷时段，按开关在站点间轮播。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Adds a configurable keyboard shortcut to the built-in DSH voice input button — Alt+V starts recording and a second press stops and transcribes; Esc closes an open voice row.
description.zh: 给 DSH 内置的语音输入按钮加可自定义的键盘快捷键：按 Alt+V 开始录音、再按一次停止并识别；Esc 关闭已打开的语音行。

description.en: Fork of cv-superding/dsh-webin (v0.2.25), extended. Desktop-only plugin that drives a real browser to run the DeepSeek, Doubao, Qwen, ChatGLM, Hunyuan and Kimi web chats as DSH model providers - real typing into the site, replies read from the page DOM, and an optional JavaScript tool protocol. No request signing or API replay. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: cv-superding/dsh-webin（v0.2.25）的派生增强版。仅桌面版：用真实浏览器把 DeepSeek、豆包、通义千问、智谱清言、腾讯元宝、Kimi 的网页版当作 DSH 模型使用——向站点输入框真打字、从页面 DOM 读回复，并可选用 JavaScript 代码块工具协议；不做请求签名、不回放接口。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Always-on-top reminder card in the bottom-right corner when an approval or question is pending, or a turn ends. Windows only.
description.zh: 待确认、待回答或任务结束时，在屏幕右下角弹出置顶提醒卡片，仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Full-window background image for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, with adjustable scrim, panel opacity, and blur in Settings > General.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 铺满整窗的背景图片，可在“设置 > 通用”中调整遮罩、面板浓度与模糊。

description.en: Session workbench: AI working time excluding approval and question waits, repeating confirmation alerts, in-conversation find, workspace explorer, and page reload.
description.zh: 会话工作台：扣除审批与提问等待的 AI 实际工作时长、重复提醒音、会话内查找、打开工作区目录与刷新页面。

description.en: Multi-phase agent workflow runner: a workflow is a YAML file of phases, links, gates and expected artifacts; a run takes one requirement input and works through the links in order, and the panel shows per-link progress, gate scores, rework counts and produced files. Registers workflow_list, workflow_get, workflow_validate and workflow_save so an agent can read, validate and save workflows.
description.zh: 多阶段 agent 工作流：工作流是含阶段、环节、门禁与期望产物的 YAML 文件，运行时只输入一次需求并按环节依次推进；面板展示每环节进度、门禁得分、返工次数与产物文件，并提供 workflow_list、workflow_get、workflow_validate、workflow_save 四个工具，让 agent 读取、校验与保存工作流。

description.en: Desktop workspace sidebar enhancements: expand or collapse all groups at once, focus on the current workspace only, and show a pulsing dot beside a workspace that has a running conversation.
description.zh: 桌面版工作区侧栏增强：一键全部展开/收起、只专注当前工作区、在有运行中对话的工作区旁显示闪烁圆点。

description.en: Adds colored macOS-style tags to workspaces and lets you insert an Emoji icon before a conversation title; tags support multiple colors, custom names, drag ordering and first/full display modes.
description.zh: 给工作区（文件夹）打彩色标签、给对话标题前插入 Emoji 图标；标签支持多色、自定义名称、拖拽排序与首/全显示。

description.en: ZenTao workbench for DeepSeek Harness with project, task and bug views, DeepSeek chat, batch task creation and daily reminders. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 禅道 AI 工作台：浏览项目、任务与 BUG，支持 DeepSeek 对话、批量建任务和今日待办提醒。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Cloud Knowledge compiles daily research from selected Zsxq groups and Tencent IMA libraries, archives sourced notes to IMA and optionally syncs highlights to a local research dashboard.
description.zh: 云知识汇总所选知识星球和腾讯 IMA 知识库的投研资料，保留出处，将详版归档至个人 IMA，并可将精选同步到量化平台。

description.en: A sidebar chat room that brings your already-existing sessions into one room to talk. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 侧栏聊天室：把已经存在的会话叫进同一个屋里说话。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Grape DevOps pipeline tools for DeepSeek Harness: 33 tools in nine groups trigger and monitor pipelines, run the issue lifecycle from create to cancel, browse scenes, managed repositories, project templates, skills and knowledge, and read ops dashboards through the grape CLI.
description.zh: Grape 的 DeepSeek Harness DevOps 工具集：九个工具组共 33 个工具，触发并跟踪流水线、走完从创建到取消的 issue 生命周期、浏览场景/托管仓库/项目模板/技能与知识库、读取运维概览，全部经由 grape CLI 调用。

description.en: Connect HiFly MCP with browser OAuth to query avatars and voices, generate speech and avatar videos, and check task results.
description.zh: 飞影 HiFly：通过浏览器授权连接 MCP，查询数字人和声音、生成配音与数字人视频、查询任务结果。

description.en: Explore cinematography concepts and motion demos, then create images or videos with configured AI services.
description.zh: 浏览摄影知识与运镜演示，通过配置的 AI 服务创作图片或视频。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness agent preset plus 24 TS8XXX-series firmware workflow skills (build, flash, log, OTA, review) for TS800X BLE development.
description.zh: TS8XXX 系列芯片固件开发插件：DSH 预设 + 构建/烧录/日志/OTA/审查等 24 个技能（当前支持 TS800X）。

description.en: A data-driven card board for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: scripts write JSON cards, each person sees their own boards
description.zh: 脚本写 JSON 卡片，插件自动生成数据看板，每个人看自己的面板

description.en: DSH Plugin: Auto-continues turns that stall on leaked DSML tool-call markup, wherever the route puts it — the reasoning or the visible text. | 当 DSML 工具调用标记泄漏在消息末尾（推理或正文皆可）导致回合停滞时，自动续跑。
description.zh: 当 DSML 工具调用标记混进推理内容、导致轮次卡住时，自动续上一轮，让对话继续跑下去。

description.en: A notification inbox for DeepSeek Harness: per-person read/unread, Web Push to phones and browsers, and buttons on every notification.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个通知收件箱，按人区分已读未读，还能推送到手机和浏览器，每条通知都带操作按钮。

description.en: 让 DSH Desktop 窗口本身跑在 WSL 里的 DSH Host 上
description.zh: 让 DSH Desktop 窗口直接跑在 WSL 里的 DSH Host 上，自动准备副本、按需启动，原安装不动。

description.en: Dreaming memory for DSH: idle passes replay session transcripts into quoted notes and a small always-injected brief, with panel, daily cadence and model selection.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供做梦式记忆：空闲时回放会话记录，整理成带逐字引文的笔记和始终注入的简报；带面板、每日定时与模型选择。

description.en: Local document search for DSH: eight kb_* tools that ingest Markdown, TXT, PDF, DOCX, HTML and JSON into workspace- and session-scoped indexes, returning matching passages with path, chapter and line-range citations; BM25 by default with optional dense retrieval, fully offline and host-only.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的本地文档检索：八个 kb_* 工具把 Markdown、TXT、PDF、DOCX、HTML、JSON 建成工作区/会话分层索引，返回带路径、章节与行号的原文片段；默认 BM25，可选稠密检索，全程离线、仅宿主侧。

description.en: DSH 引用元素插件：把界面元素、链接、文件路径一键引用成原生 composer chip | Element reference chips for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面里点哪引哪，把元素、链接、文件路径一键变成输入框里的原生引用 chip。

description.en: Market Dog, the plugin bloodhound: locate the right plugin from a one-sentence or keyword description with bilingual (Chinese/English) semantic matching. Sort by relevance or downloads; filter by category, update time and stars.
description.zh: Market Dog（寻“plugin”猎犬）：根据一句话或关键词描述快速定位目标插件， 中英双语语义匹配，支持相关度、下载量排序及类别/更新时间/Star 筛选。

description.en: RouterAI для DeepSeek Harness: сотни моделей по одному ключу с оплатой в рублях, картинки, видео, озвучка
description.zh: 一个密钥就能调用几百种大模型，还支持图片、视频和语音，用卢布付款。

description.en: Back up and restore a whole DSH environment (installed plugins, DSH and plugin settings, skills, sessions and explicitly registered workspace files) into one private GitHub repository. Multiple machines share a single repo through per-device namespaces that never overwrite each other, and a pull can restore from this device, the latest backup or a chosen device. Push previews a read-only plan before writing, pull backs up local data first, secret-looking settings are redacted and key files are never uploaded. It calls api.github.com with the GitHub token you save in the panel (kept host-side only); its HTTP routes (/one-pack/api/...) require DSH browser auth.
description.zh: 把整套 DSH 环境（已装插件、DSH 与插件设置、技能、会话、显式登记的工作区文件） 打包同步到一个私有 GitHub 仓库。多台设备共用同一仓库时各写自己的设备命名空间、 互不覆盖，拉取可选本设备、最新备份或指定设备；推送前先只读预览计划，拉取前自动 备份本地数据；疑似密钥字段写成掩码、密钥文件硬排除，GitHub token 只保存在 Host 本地。它会用面板里保存的 token 访问 api.github.com；HTTP 路由 （/one-pack/api/…）要求 DSH 浏览器鉴权。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for effort & token insights by date and workspace, plus multi-device sync. DSH 工作量报告插件：按日期与工作区看清「我的付出」与 Token 消耗，含日历热力图 / 时刻分析 / 工作区占比 / 模型用量，可导出自包含 HTML 报告，并支持多设备用量同步（COS / GitHub / Gitea / 共享目录）。
description.zh: 按日期和工作区统计你的投入与 Token 消耗，用日历热力图看清时间和钱都花在哪了。
装在每台机器上的接单小助手，主动连回主控节点领任务，公司内网也能用。

description.en: DSH Web 插件：把本机 CPU / 内存 / 磁盘 / 网络 / I/O / 温度显示在对话顶栏、输入框底部、侧边栏底部，点开右侧「系统」详情
description.zh: 在对话顶栏、输入框和侧边栏实时显示本机 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络、温度和 I/O，点开右侧「系统」看详情。

description.en: A clickable wooden-fish desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI. Click to knock; counts per day with a calendar heatmap of your streaks in settings. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面打造的电子木鱼桌宠。点击敲击、按天计数，设置页以日历热力图展示每日敲击与连续天数。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。
